positive_snippets: A pleasant stay spent in this hotel! A welcoming and warm place like its managers and staff. I had the feeling of living with my family ❤️The striking and very important fact that seduced me was the cleanliness of the setting👍🏼, and also the security. However, since no work is perfect, as a suggestion, emphasis should be placed on training maintenance personnel in the requirements of hotel standards. Thank you and good luck to you.

spacious rooms, convenient location and value for money. The staff was very accommodating to give me an early check-in. My room had a balcony (facing a park) and a kitchen, which made it even more spacious. The staff was always very welcoming and prompt, the breakfast served was good. Recommended, would love to book for my future visits as well.

Very nice and friendly staff which is always available on a short call. 😊
Neat and clean spacious rooms along with small kitchen attached has made our stay more comfortable!! 🤟🏻
Best locality in this area where we can get all the basic amenities very easily. 😎
Most importantly, there is dedicated parking area which adds more stars to this fabulous hotel!! ✨
